truth_boundary: inventory-and-installation-guidance-only; current host registry and live probes remain required

dependencies.detection: scripts/secure_runner.py --platform-audit
dependencies.installation: Install a Python version listed in runtime/python-dependency-lock.json or generate a review-only candidate; never self-promote a candidate into the release lock.

dependencies.detection: registry_assurance reports either current-session-model-visible-intent or an adapter-declared host.registry.export trace
dependencies.installation: Codex Desktop uses init-current-session-census with only the actual model-visible identifier set plus a verified installed release; it remains non-attested and requires later live probes. A higher-assurance harness must expose host.registry.export and generate the export itself. Operators must never handwrite loaded/available, provider/session, installed paths, or a synthetic host export.

dependencies.detection: node --version
dependencies.installation: Install Node.js 20 or newer through the host package manager.

dependencies.detection: image.generate.opaque route resolves to image_gen__imagegen in the current registry census
dependencies.installation: Enable a host image-generation callable and map its actual provider/session through the selected adapter. It may not be relabelled as an RGBA provider unless that route passes the independent Alpha contract.

dependencies.detection: image.inspect route resolves to view_image or an equivalent adapter-declared callable in the current registry census
dependencies.installation: Enable a current-session image inspection callable; schema discovery alone is not an image read.

dependencies.detection: cloudflared --version
dependencies.installation: macOS: brew install cloudflared; Windows: winget install Cloudflare.cloudflared.

dependencies.detection: host Skill registry plus c2c session/tunnel status for the exact workspace root
dependencies.installation: Install the codex-with-chatgpt Skill and its built checkout, then bind a connector/Project to the exact current worktree.

dependencies.detection: host Skill registry and Browser runtime bootstrap
dependencies.installation: Install/enable the built-in Browser skill and expose its complete runtime, not a generic JavaScript executor.

dependencies.conditional_on: selected Browser or Computer Use adapter route
dependencies.detection: the complete adapter route contains mcp__node_repl__js in the same provider/session
dependencies.installation: Expose the reviewed Browser/Computer Use JavaScript runtime. A standalone shell or unrelated JavaScript executor does not satisfy this route.

dependencies.detection: host Skill registry and current app binding
dependencies.installation: Install/enable Computer Use only as the declared UI fallback; it is forbidden for the ChatGPT image route.

dependencies.detection: browser.download.ingest route plus scripts/ingest_browser_download.py in the verified release
dependencies.installation: Expose the Browser-observed absolute download path and current provider trace identifiers, then run the locked local create-once ingestion processor. This is current-session integrity, not signed browser-event attestation.

dependencies.conditional_on: the harness wants an additional local policy veto for formal generated article assets
dependencies.detection: the image.provider.acquire.authority compatibility route resolves to a host policy hook and evaluates the exact census/migration/provider/request/ingestion/raw challenge
dependencies.installation: Optional only. The callback may veto, but True never upgrades assurance and the callback is not host attestation. Current-session operation instead requires the complete migration, canonical request, create-once ingestion, exact raw bytes, and RGBA pixel chain.

dependencies.conditional_on: the operator requires portable-signed provider assurance
dependencies.detection: a real host.receipt.attest route signs org-wechat-provider-image-host-receipt-v1 over the exact provider acquisition challenge, and the repository verifies it against a protected external Ed25519 trust store
dependencies.installation: Provide the signer and trust store outside repository control. A receipt file, JSON authorized field, migration report, Browser trace, or repository-created key cannot satisfy the host capability.

dependencies.detection: runtime/python-dependency-lock.json importable census and allowed_entrypoints match the current scripts directory
dependencies.installation: Use only the reviewed secure-runner entrypoints for download ingestion, cutout, inspection, watermark, Ardot handoff, transport validation, compilation and publishing. Do not install shadow copies on PYTHONPATH.

dependencies.detection: registry census injects scripts/wechat_publisher.py as kind wechat.draft and the execution-time credential probe succeeds
dependencies.installation: Keep scripts/wechat_publisher.py in the verified lock. Resolve WECHAT_ACCESS_TOKEN and WECHAT_APP_ID only at execution; never put them in the registry intent/export, census, profile, report or URL. The CLI does not exchange AppSecret for an access token.

dependencies.conditional_on: targets.wechat.mode is api, terminal_state is draft, and portable signed readback is not selected
dependencies.detection: wechat.current-session-readback binds one complete Browser/Computer Use route and scripts/ingest_wechat_readback_capture.py in the same current host session
dependencies.installation: Open the exact API-saved draft, capture one actual 390px PNG per chapter, and run the locked create-once ingestor. The bundle is host_attested=false, portable=false, publication_authority=false and never satisfies freepublish authority.

dependencies.conditional_on: terminal_state is publish and the selected route is api without portable receipts
dependencies.detection: wechat.current-session-authority is independently present in the current registry census and later consumes a fresh confirmation plus authoritative account/draft readback
dependencies.installation: Provide an in-process host callable. scripts/wechat_publisher.py and wechat.draft alone never satisfy or imply this authority. Without it, keep terminal_state=draft, select a declared live UI route, or use portable signed receipts.

dependencies.detection: current Browser or Computer Use route opens the credential-free base URL and authoritatively reads the exact visible account
dependencies.installation: Enable one complete UI route. If a login or QR wall is actually visible, keep the page open for the user and re-probe the exact account in the same session after login.

dependencies.conditional_on: the complete artifact inventory contains one or more eligible watermark carriers
dependencies.detection: secret.resolve reports only valid/present booleans for PROVENANCE_WATERMARK_KEY and a writable non-symlink Git-external private root
dependencies.installation: Provision a random key of at least 32 bytes as hex: or base64: plus a Git-external private root. Do not require these secrets when a complete inventory has no eligible carriers.

dependencies.detection: filesystem.access.lease capability in the current host registry
dependencies.installation: Optional high-assurance upgrade: the host enforces a deny-by-default allowlist for the current input, pack and runtime output and denies examples, other organizations, old outputs and old Ardot references. Without it, use only a verified source-zero installed release whose package excludes those trees.

dependencies.detection: host.migration.finalize capability plus protected public trust store
dependencies.installation: Optional portable-signed upgrade: the host signs the bound probe receipt and enforces its one-time nonce in a host-owned replay ledger. Current-session operation must not claim this assurance.

dependencies.detection: host.receipt.attest capability plus protected public trust store
dependencies.installation: Optional portable-audit upgrade: keep the Ed25519 private key outside repository processes and sign fresh authoritative Ardot and WeChat readback bytes. Its absence does not block current-session draft work or a separately confirmed live publish.
